mentions.name: RCHIVE standalone CLI components
mentions.description: This planned set of free standalone packages exposes the discrete, decoupled components underlying RCHIVE and RCHIVE Examiner for people who might find them useful, especially in CLI scenarios.
mentions.source_excerpt: There are a handful of discrete, decoupled components underlying both apps as well that people might find useful (especially in CLI scenarios) that I'm also planning on releasing gratis as soon as I get a chance to package them up standalone.
